key.name: delay
key.summary: Delay in seconds before the capture

key.name: save-to-disk
key.summary: Save screenshots to disk (when off they are only copied to the clipboard)

key.name: show-history
key.summary: Show the recent screenshots section in the popover

key.name: history-expanded
key.summary: Whether the recent screenshots section is expanded

key.name: show-emoji
key.summary: Show a random face in the panel when a screenshot is taken

key.name: icon-style
key.summary: Mode button icons: classic (old applet) or budgie (Budgie Screenshot)

key.name: flash
key.summary: Flash the screen when a screenshot is taken

key.name: copy-to-clipboard
key.summary: Copy every screenshot to the clipboard (needs wl-copy)

key.name: show-notification
key.summary: Show a notification after taking a screenshot

key.name: play-sound
key.summary: Play the camera shutter sound (needs canberra-gtk-play)

key.name: reopen-popover
key.summary: Re-open the applet after taking a screenshot

key.name: show-thumbnails
key.summary: Show thumbnails in the history list

key.name: history-size
key.summary: Number of recent screenshots to remember

key.name: editor-command
key.summary: Editor command, file path is appended (empty = auto-detect satty/swappy)
